mom_truck: ^Mom: There you are! The truck beat us here.
^Mom: Our new house is just up the road. Go on in and set the clock upstairs — movers hate waiting.
house_1f: ^Mover: Careful with that box! It's got your posters in it.
^Mover: The stairs are right there. Clock's upstairs.
house_2f_clock: ^You set the clock on the wall. It ticks, once, and keeps going.
rival_house: ^Hex's Mom: Oh! You're the new neighbours! Hex is out back — go say hello, you two will be thick as thieves.
route_rescue: ^Prof. Aeon: Help! This wild creature has me cornered!
^Prof. Aeon: Quick — take one from my bag and drive it off!
lab: ^Prof. Aeon: Phew. Thank you. That bag is yours to keep, and so is the creature inside it.
^Prof. Aeon: This is your Mochiioteca. It records every Mochiichao you meet.
^Prof. Aeon: Now go — Route 1.0 is waiting, and Silicon Town is just past it.
mom_boots: ^Mom: Off already? Here — Sprint Boots. They'll get you there twice as fast.
^Mom: Come back and talk to me any time — I'll patch your partner right up.
